_doc: AL-83: memory budget. Each pool has a world total; a living person gets total / people clamped to [per_min, per_max], so the more people, the less each keeps. Trimmed daily: memories by salience (oldest first), recipes by worth (masters, breakthroughs, the player's named ones are kept), craft novelty counters by count. said = SaidMemory (what was said, for cooldowns): per person x people is the world cap, older than said_keep_days goes. A crafted chain longer than max_recipe_steps is not written to the book.
